title: Trump told of hybrids living among us during his briefing

tellings.quote: Trump was during that briefing he was told that there are hybrids and told the narrative that they were that there's hybrids that potentially live amongst us and and that Trump's response was, "You mean like Adam Schiff?"

plain: During a briefing on UFOs, Donald Trump was told that part-human, part-alien hybrids may be living among us, and he answered, "You mean like Adam Schiff?", naming a Democratic congressman who was one of his political rivals. Congressman Eric Burlison tells this as an account he heard about the briefing, not something he saw himself. If true, it would mean a president was given this story officially.
